description: Search all 103,372 variants (not only the 40-car demo). Returns opaque variant_ids for get_specs_full. Paid per call with x402 (USDC) — $0.005.

locale.description: Response language, one of the 20 published languages (en, ro, fr, de, es, it, sr, hr, pt, pl, cs, sk, hu, no, sv, el, bg, da, ar, tr). Spec labels and enum values come back translated. Default: en.

query.description: Free text matched against brand, model and variant names, accent- and punctuation-insensitive — e.g. 'bmw 3 series' or 'tesla model s'.

name: search_catalogue

display_name.description: Full variant name, localized when a translation exists

variant_id.description: Opaque variant id, e.g. v_1a2b3c4d. Pass it to get_specs_full.

year_from.description: First production year of the generation

year_to.description: Last production year; 0 or null while still in production

title: Search the full catalogue (paid)
